samples.question: The sheet shows a square lattice of 4 by 4 points; the four corner points are printed as coloured squares. Every printed stroke runs straight along a lattice line from one point to the next point, and all strokes use the same ink. Strokes come in two thicknesses. Below the sheet a solid reference bar is printed; the height of that bar is the sanding width. Sand the sheet: erase every stroke that is thinner than the reference bar, and keep every stroke that is at least as thick as the reference bar. The strokes that survive the sanding form one of these five symbols: comb (a full top bar with three teeth hanging down), hood (a full top bar with both ends turning down two steps), jhook (a full left side and a full bottom bar with the right end turning up one step), rungs (two full horizontal bars, the second and fourth rows, joined by one vertical link), zig (a staircase running down from the top left corner to the bottom right corner and back one step to the left). Which symbol survives? Answer with one word.
